signature.basis: RE-BASELINE (replaces an earlier signature), at PINNED_AS_OF 2026-09-09, extraction v30. Re-baselined in Session 23 for two reasons, neither a correction of the previous reading. (1) THE CORPUS MOVED — the 10-K (moh-20251231.htm) is no longer in the cited set, so the v29 pin describes a corpus that is not the current one and cannot be compared against it (Rule 30). (2) THE EXTRACTION MOVED — `drawn` is now $0, stated by the anchor ("As of June 30, 2026, no amount was outstanding under the Credit Agreement") and recovered by Rule 53 once its noun matcher admitted the copula; and `lettersOfCredit` is now null, correctly: the v29 value of $100 million was the letter of credit SUB-FACILITY's limit, not letters of credit outstanding, which is Rule 48's category error. The filing states no LC balance for Molina, so null is the honest answer. Ruled by the signer on 2026-09-21 against the sentences themselves. Five ladder sourceLines also collapsed from two period columns to one — cosmetic provenance, amounts and dates unchanged. Ladder amounts, subtotals and totals hand-verified against the filings; no wrong number found. Every displayed figure checked against the sentence shown beside it, not merely present somewhere in the corpus (Rule 46) — belonging clean, 0 composites. Facility maturities verified against their own sentences; where the instrument's own cited sentence does not state the date, it is taken from the facility's own maturity sentence and labelled when that sits outside the anchor. CACHE_BUST x3 at v30 on 2026-09-21 (lib/cache/s23molinarepro.ts, $0.6257): 6 rows in every run; every row identical across all three on identity, amount, maturity date, granularity, provenance and capacity flag; coverage identical (statedTotalDebt, capturedFace, statedBridge, denominator). TESTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED because v30 had already given two different answers for `drawn` earlier in the session — null on the cold pass, $0 on the refresh. Across these three it held at $0 every time, with every other facility figure identical too, so the value the re-baseline pins is one that reproduces. Facility figures are NOT covered by 9b and were measured separately for exactly that reason.

results.evidence: No asset sale or divestiture is disclosed in the current period filings. The company exited the MAPD product line (Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug) effective 2027, but this is a product exit, not an asset sale. Virginia Medicaid contracts terminated effective June 30, 2025, but this was a contract non-renewal, not a sale.

Molina Healthcare operates exclusively in the United States under Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace programs. No international operations or foreign revenue is disclosed in any of the filings provided.
No new subsidiary formation is disclosed in the public filings. New subsidiary formation is typically an internal matter not disclosed unless tied to a reported acquisition or material transaction.
No IPO or secondary equity offering is disclosed. Molina Healthcare is an established public company trading on the NYSE under ticker MOH. No equity offering is mentioned in the filings.

All outstanding debt consists of fixed-rate senior notes: 4.375% due 2028, 3.875% due 2030, 6.500% due 2031, 3.875% due 2032, and 6.250% due 2033. The revolving credit facility is undrawn. No floating-rate debt is outstanding.

No material commodity or input-cost exposure is disclosed in the risk factors or MD&A sections of the filings provided. The company's primary cost drivers are medical care costs, pharmacy costs, and provider payments, which are not commodity-based.
No material foreign-currency exposure is disclosed. Molina Healthcare operates exclusively in the United States and has no international operations or foreign currency transactions.
